description: Jones-polynomial sign sweep across the first three metallic-ladder intervals. Companion to the Wenzl-y_λ sweep, which returned NULL (Wenzl weights stay positive for all real q > 0). This probe tests whether the metallic-piecewise structure shows up at the level of Jones polynomials of canonical knots (unknot, trefoil, figure-eight, 5_1, Hopf).

verdict.interpretation: If sign(J_K(q)) jumps EXACTLY at metallic ratios for some knot K and stays constant within each metallic interval, the conjecture is empirically confirmed at the Jones-polynomial level for that K. If signs change WITHIN an interval (a crossing not at a metallic ratio), the metallic structure is not the controlling boundary for that knot's sign.

limitations: Jones polynomials are simple test functions — they are not the SDP-feasibility criterion the framework actually uses. A true test needs character χ_λ(β) sign tracking, which requires re-pinning per-nucleus character witnesses at counterfactual q.
Hopf link uses fractional powers; sign comparison is well-defined for q > 0 real.
The 5_1 torus knot Jones polynomial uses the standard right-handed convention; mirror image would flip overall sign.
